title: Kid-Friendly Velvety American Plum Jam Bars
description: These kid-friendly bars are made with a floral and velvety plum jam filling, perfect for a sweet treat.

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.additional: use a salt block to make it ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly

instructions: Line an 8x8 inch baking dish with parchment paper.
In a medium bowl, whisk together flour and confectioners sugar.
Add softened butter and mix until a crumbly mixture forms.
Press the mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until lightly golden brown.
Let cool for 10 minutes, then prick the surface with a fork.
Spread plum jam evenly over the surface of the baked crust.
In a small bowl, whisk together eggs, vanilla extract, and granulated sugar (if using).
Pour the egg mixture evenly over the plum jam.
Bake for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the surface is set and the edges are lightly golden brown.
Let cool completely before cutting into bars.
